paper.title_en: Dissecting the variability of Sagittarius A* in the orbiting hotspot framework
paper.abstract_en: Sagittarius A* (Sgr A*) exhibits intermittent flaring behavior, characterized by strong enhancements in high-energy emission (infrared and X-ray). These events have been interpreted as related to the coherent orbital motion of localized regions of energized plasma - hotspots. While this framework has been quite fruitful in constraining properties of Sgr A*, it is subject to important challenges and limitations. In this brief review we discuss the recent observational and theoretical developments related to this line of research, commenting on the concerns regarding the hotspot model validity and the future perspectives.
